How a school swarms

collective motion for the aquarium level’s ten followers · the Couzin zone model, measured against our own Forth implementation
Lengths are in body lengths (BL; a fish is 3.5 in). The tank is 13.4 × 3.4 × 4.7 BL inside. A school is polarised (p_group near 1); a swarm is not (p near 0.1): moving one zone width, Δr_o, switches between them.
A · Four collective states from one rule, simulated here (N = 100, the paper’s r_r, α, θ, s, σ)
B · The model: three zones and a blind volume
C · The map: p_group over the two zone widths
D · The rule in eight lines, and the Forth word that does each
F · The Forth core, school.fth: the four rule words in full (the rest is in the file), and what it costs
G · The Forth, running in the tank: swarm, torus, school, and a startle
Sources · live links in the PDF; what could not be verified is marked

How to read the chips

verified the source was opened; the number is on its page
unverified from a summary, or not opened
ours our own choice, maths or measurement

Not claimed: that real clownfish school (they do not), that our sweep shows the paper’s hysteresis (it is too coarse), or that the Forth was timed inside the engine. Data dated 2026‑10‑01.
